decision.authority: owner d1b9f3c0 / correction7d8d831e; worker w4 first homepage review
decision.rationale: The official Faculty of Medicine homepage explains its institutional vision, equity commitment and province-wide academic community. It also identifies a film featuring people who embody that vision and an explicit film-award announcement. Academic mission is the host default, with the evidenced film narrative routed to stories and MUSE award announcements to news. The public content is not personal, login-only or Okanagan-exclusive.
evidence: https://vision.med.ubc.ca/ | 82d2e9e835eb5f484b97c9f2643790a11847ac3efbf02bfe2b8076a7a337bea4 | As one of the world’s leading medical schools, UBC’s Faculty of Medicine has a bold vision: to transform health for everyone.

https://vision.med.ubc.ca/ | 82d2e9e835eb5f484b97c9f2643790a11847ac3efbf02bfe2b8076a7a337bea4 | The film Vision: Transforming Health for Everyone is the winner of two internationally-recognized platinum MUSE Creative Awards for 2020.

https://vision.med.ubc.ca/ | 82d2e9e835eb5f484b97c9f2643790a11847ac3efbf02bfe2b8076a7a337bea4 | Watch our film to learn more about the many people at the Faculty of Medicine who exemplify this vision by being transformative, inclusive, passionate, authentic and driven by a collective desire for a more equitable, healthier world for all people.
https://vision.med.ubc.ca/ | 82d2e9e835eb5f484b97c9f2643790a11847ac3efbf02bfe2b8076a7a337bea4 | more than 16,000 faculty, staff and students spread out over a vast, rugged and richly diverse province

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly announces the film's MUSE Creative Awards; documents titled for that award are announcements rather than academic-program information.
The named film tells the stories of Faculty of Medicine people who exemplify its vision.

fallback.rationale: The site's primary purpose is the UBC medical school's institutional vision, values and academic-community mission.
